title: MURPHY’S LAWS OF AI ALIGNMENT: WHY THE GAP ALWAYS WINS
reasoning: The paper provides a theoretical and mathematical analysis of AI alignment and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), focusing on how misspecified or biased feedback affects sample complexity. While alignment is a core topic in AI ethics, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark specific religious beliefs, moral codes, or ethical frameworks; it analyzes the optimization and learning process itself.
